A goofy, non-sexual beach gag costume. Dance: a confident strut on the spot, swinging the hips and rolling the shoulders. Plain seamless solid light grey studio backdrop with nothing else in the picture: no props, no text, no logo. Realistic video footage of a real-looking, ordinary, invented person who is not any celebrity or real individual. Early-1990s public-access TV or corporate training tape look: slightly soft analogue video picture, warm colours, bright even studio lighting.
